capabilities: Search all vault files from a browser-like new tab
Filter search by file type or extension
Show starred and recent files under the search bar
Embed the search bar in notes via a code block
Replace or open new tabs through commands
extras: The README warns the plugin is not actively maintained and may conflict with other plugins that replace new tabs, such as Obsidian-Surfing. It can also be installed via BRAT.
intentEvidence: not meant to be a replacement for the default Quick switcher or any alternative one like Another quick switcher
motivation: The author wanted a faster way to open a note or file right after opening a new tab, taking inspiration from Another quick switcher.
problem: Obsidian opens new tabs empty, so opening a note or file requires switching to another tool like the Quick switcher.

relations.evidence: any alternative one like Another quick switcher (from which I took inspiration)

summary: Browser-like new tab view with a search bar and starred files grid for quickly opening files in the vault.
